aspect: Rights are reduced at the border by design
description: At a port of entry the ordinary protections are sharply narrowed: phones can be searched without a warrant under the border search exception, and a visa holder can be returned on the next flight.
energy_note: Lawful, and nothing like the country you thought you were entering.

aspect: No clock the target can see
description: Inspections run from thirty minutes to many hours. Nobody states a duration, and asking how long is itself read as impatience.
energy_note: No end time, and asking for one counts against you.

aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the officer who is enjoying it
description: He reads her landing card, puts it down, and says nothing for forty seconds. Then: 'Sit down. I didn't say you could stand.' Every ten minutes he walks past and does not look at her. At the ninety-minute mark he returns, stamps it, and says 'See? Nothing to worry about.' Nothing improper has occurred and she will not be able to describe what did.
energy_note: Ninety minutes of nothing, administered deliberately.

aspect: The complaint route requires naming the officer
description: Redress mechanisms exist and require details the target was never given: a badge number they could not see, a name nobody said, a time nobody recorded.
energy_note: A complaints process that requires facts they withheld.
